market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a co-founder of the Movimento Brasil Livre (MBL), a right‑wing activist group with limited national recognition.  He has never been a major candidate, no significant party backing is evident, and no credible polls place him among top contenders for 2026.  The chance of an obscure activist finishing second in a presidential election is negligible, far below the market‑implied 6.7%.
evidence_points: Renan Santos is known as an MBL activist and former candidate for local office, not a national presidential contender.
MBL has no track record of achieving the nationwide support required for a top‑two finish in a Brazilian presidential election.
No public polls or major party announcements indicate Santos as even a minor candidate for 2026.
sources_consulted: Knowledge of Brazilian political landscape (up to 2024)
General election dynamics and MBL coverage in news media
